notes.title: Announcing Juice Fest! NextFest Edition
notes.content:
Hello JUICERS!

You might have noticed (or not) that the JUICE Demo has an Arcade mode, were you must eat 300 humans in the least amount of time:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931004/dd7754373d4dd320feb53b3aea1c22ec2167fa2a.gif

Well...  starting today and ending on October 21 the BEST 10 players in the world with the BEST Arcade speedrun times can compete to win:


 A dope engraved Colorfiction hat of your choosing!
 A Big a$$ Juice prints made of archival paper and ink!
 Exclusive alpha/beta access to the game as it's developed!
 And my fave: the chance to be in game NPCs!

Super friggin Juicy right?

Sooo how does this work? EASY:

1. Get really good at Arcade mode.

2. Post a screenshot of your best time on twitter or instagram with the #juicegamefest tag

3. and... that's it! 

After October 22 I'll scour socials, announce a list of best times, and reach out so you can claim these awesome juicy prizes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931004/8173bcc15e038a891c1206c31455ef9cb3ebd7f4.png

This past Pax East 2024 I held the first Juice Fest, with thousands of players competing for similar prizes and it turned into a total feeding frenzy. Ultimately 6 champions triumphed and have since been immortalized:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931004/b68c11f0c4aec006678f487d0827fa2cf3889c7c.png

But tbh I think you can all totally smoke these fools and their best times (if yous og PAX champions are reading this whatsup! big hug, this is another chance to be the ultimate Juice champions).

What are you waiting for? 
 GET JUICING!
